title: Fashion walk through the tunnel
idea: a model in a flowing red dress walks towards the camera through a concrete tunnel
style: editorial fashion film, high contrast, muted concrete tones against saturated red
subject: a tall model in a long red silk dress and black boots, hair loose
setting: a concrete pedestrian tunnel with strip lights along the ceiling, puddles on the floor
light: cold fluorescent strip lights as key from above, warm light at the far end of the tunnel as backlight

beats.action: she stands at the far end of the tunnel in silhouette against the warm light, then starts walking
she walks towards the camera with a steady stride, the dress trailing
beats.camera: slow pull-back ahead of her, matching her pace

beats.action: the strip lights pass overhead and catch the silk; she looks straight into the lens
she stops, turns her shoulder and the dress swings around her
the dress settles; she holds the pose

physics: silk floats and ripples behind her, slow to settle; boots plant firmly on each step with small splashes in the puddles; hair moves with the head and settles a moment later

sound.fx: boot heels on wet concrete, fabric rustle

image_ref: the model standing at the far end of the tunnel, full body, silhouette with the red dress catching light; the dress, boots and tunnel geometry stay as in the image
notes: Vertical; 10 s uses five beats with one camera change at 2 s and one at 8 s.
